description: Keeps the repetition guard (non-navigation actions warned at 3+, navigation at 4+, look/inventory at 5+, discourage at 4+) and the 'Nothing happens' streak note unchanged, but makes the step-budget reminder earlier and periodic: from step 20 on, emit 'Steps used so far: N of 50' on every step that is a multiple of 5, so the agent notices the budget before it has burned most of it. All notes state only counts and observed 'Nothing happens' results from the episode's own stream.
header: Action counts, failure streaks, and earlier periodic step-budget reminders.
